scene: The basket drops you at a bustling mid-air transit hub.
picture: Side-scrolling view of a metal transit hub platform floating in the night sky. On the far left waits a red double-decker hover bus with open doors. The pink-tracksuit grandmother and her dog stand left-of-centre near the empty cargo basket. On the right, a striped gondola drone floats tethered, beside a neon flying scooter on the far right.
shown: a red double-decker hover bus parked waiting on the far left
a striped gondola drone tethered to a pole on the right
a parked neon flying scooter standing on the far right
